title: The Archive Studio's engine, and the catalogue of studies
about: The engine of linked data, a program around the API's composition of symploke compiled with g++ 11 or later (natively or in WSL) into data/cache/engines/archive-studio/linked/; then, for the catalogue, the first pages of the CESSDA Data Catalogue harvested by OAI-PMH (some 200 studies of Europe's social-science data archives, about 1 MB, kept in the cache only: the catalogue states no licence for its descriptions). A project of one's own holdings needs only the engine.
